# Hypothesis Testing

## Procedure
Specify hypothesis, one primary metric, baseline, variants, cost, test window, minimum sample, stop conditions, confounders; compare like-for-like cohorts.

## Evidence and safety
Never invent access, API responses, metrics, sources, or licenses. Label estimates and confidence. Follow approval gates in `CLAUDE.md` and produce an explicit result plus next test.
